title: Payment Standing Share of the Fleet Diagnostic Credit — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the diagnostic standing share follows the account's payment record:
- where a late fee was assessed on the account within the last twelve whole months and no payment was returned in that time, the credit is multiplied by 0.75;
- where a payment was returned on the account within the last twelve whole months, by 0.5;
- otherwise it is not reduced.

**Window.** A record falls within the last twelve whole months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the day the credit is worked out, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day, so records dated on that day count.

| Late fee in the window | Returned payment in the window | Multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 0.75 |
| Either | Yes | 0.5 |
| No | No | not reduced |
